NB: New improved maize varieties were ranked 8th among the new agricultural/NRM practices and the youths knew little about these varieties.

Use of new varieties of maize (; 1) and cowpeas. Cowpea is very important to us because we can use it as stock feed, its leaves is used as relish and the seed is used directly as food when boiled. There are new varieties of maize that have been introduced in the area but we do not know their names.
New maize seed varieties are important because they are drought tolerant. This is a good trait because of the amount of rainfall we receive is declining due to climate change.
New improved maize varieties are important because they mature early.
The new improved maize varieties gives higher yields than the old varieties. What we are not sure of is whether these varieties are GMOs [Genetically modified] or not.
[Remarking on one who had ranked CA number 1]: Hum, CA is an issue. Doing CA makes one age faster.

Important crops
Wheat

Its importance has declined because of the dollarization and the availability of goods in the shops. In 2004 there was a shortage of bread that is why we valued it most. These days flour is readily available and bread companies make deliveries to our communities.
Climate change has caused a decline in wheat production because it needs a lot of rain to do well.
Maize and finger millet
Maize is always number one because it is the staple food.
Finger millet is a substitute of maize as a staple food and it is used to brew beer.
As youth, finger millet is used by our parents to generate money for school fees.
Cowpea

Cowpea does not require a lot of rain and is thus important given the changing climate which has caused a decline in the amount of rainfall we now receive. This has increased in importance because donors/NGOs are promoting the crop. The new variety of cowpea can also be planted twice in one rainy season because it is an early maturity variety.

The new cowpea variety is easy to harvest and because it is not a runner, it does not disturb maize if intercropped with maize. It gives a higher yield than the local cowpea variety which we have grown over the years.

Yes, young people around here really follow these customs of women doing certain agricultural activities and men doing others because we follow our traditional practices. Chickens and goats are preferred by women because they are easy to look after.
Groundnuts, cowpeas, roundnuts, pumpkins and cowpeas are mostly preferred by women because traditionally they are for women.
Our parents will reject that idea of a women trying to grow and sell maize.

Most households in XX have one plot for the whole family but in other households women request a plot to grow groundnut and roundnuts.
Growing crops in a certain plot depends with which crop does well on that type of soil. If the maize does not do well on a certain plot, a woman can grow groundnuts and roundnuts on that plot.
If the household has many plots a woman can get a plot to grow her own crops.
Deciding on which crops to grow depends on the type of soil in the field.

Gender equality means having equal opportunity between men and women in looking for jobs and at work, not in the home. It is difficult to change our traditional practices [which assigns roles by gender].
